category_law: Limitations of what was demonstrated on synthetic carriers. Stated so a reviewer can discount the result correctly.

defects_and_constraints.title: Chunked DTA requires a FRESH broker per chunk
defects_and_constraints.observed: Reusing one broker across successive row_offset chunk parses of a DTA carrier fails with ReadstatError 'This version of the file format is not supported'. Opening a fresh broker per chunk succeeds and returns all rows.
defects_and_constraints.root_cause: ReadStat's DTA row_offset parse expects the underlying file at position 0. A reused broker has an advanced position.
defects_and_constraints.consequence: pyreadstat's read_file_in_chunks helper cannot be used as-is for DTA under brokering. The application must drive the chunk loop itself.
defects_and_constraints.why_it_matters: DTA is the format SRC27 uses, and the chunked path is the reader site earlier lanes flagged as unmeasured.
defects_and_constraints.mitigation: Application-owned loop with a fresh broker per chunk. Confirmed working in synthetic DTA: 4 rows, 2 opens, 114 reads, 3748 bytes.
defects_and_constraints.risk_if_ignored: Loud failure, not silent corruption. Negative case N5.

defects_and_constraints.title: The seam is de facto, not a documented API
defects_and_constraints.observed: pyreadstat exposes no public named file-handler or I/O-callback registration surface, and no pyreadstat.FileLike attribute. The handler set is installed internally by duck-typing on .read and .seek.
defects_and_constraints.consequence: The mechanism is an implementation detail. A future pyreadstat release could remove or alter it without notice.
defects_and_constraints.mitigation: Pin the pyreadstat version and add an assertion that the seam still behaves, so a change is detected rather than silently disabling governance.

defects_and_constraints.title: Byte ceilings are pre-read gates, not byte-exact cuts
defects_and_constraints.observed: With a 16-byte ceiling, 23 bytes were delivered before the fourth read was refused.
defects_and_constraints.consequence: Delivered bytes may exceed the maximum by up to one in-flight read.
defects_and_constraints.why_not_fixed: Byte-exact truncation would corrupt the stream and change decode behaviour, which is out of scope and undesirable.

scope_limitations: Tiny synthetic carriers only: 4 rows, 2 numeric variables. Not representative of real files.
Metadata comparison was limited to column names and row counts. A full metadata-field diff was NOT performed.
Two formats exercised: .sav and .dta. Not exercised: SAS7BDAT, XPORT, POR, SAS7BCAT.
Encoding, user-missing, extended-missing, date/time and value-label behaviour were not varied and are therefore untested.
No concurrency, multiprocessing, num_processes, or large-file behaviour was tested. The broker is not shown to be thread-safe.
The open-count ceiling was implemented but not exercised as a negative case.
coverage_limitations_that_undermine_any_: Any reader call site that still passes a raw path string is NOT governed by this mechanism. No inventory of such sites was produced. Coverage is opt-in per call site and is only as complete as that inventory, which does not yet exist.

Accounting is at the application-owned file object. It is NOT OS-level, kernel-level, or per-descriptor accounting. A reviewer requiring descriptor-level truth would still need privilege, which remains unavailable.
Reads performed outside pyreadstat by the application itself, such as a separate header inspection, are outside the broker's view unless deliberately routed through it.
The broker proves the compiled reader performs zero path opens. It does not prove anything about what the application would do if a future change re-introduced a path-based call.
authority_and_process_limitations: Zero real-source operations, locator discovery, warrants, live C4, production mutation, C7 or actor/person work. All holds respected.
rawlsing_next was not modified. No production change is proposed.
The accepted R7 environment was not mutated. No disposable rebuild was needed, because no rebuild was required.
Hostile independent review has NOT occurred. This result is unreviewed.
The prior lanes' failures were not re-litigated: DYLD was not retried, and the four under-bounded account classes from HQ190-C were not reopened.
explicit_non_claims: NOT a claim of survey-semantic equivalence.
NOT a claim that any real source is governable under this design.
NOT a claim that the change is production-ready or authorised.
NOT a claim that literal O1-C07 is satisfied at OS or kernel level. It is satisfied at the application-owned file object, which is where the reader's I/O actually occurs on this route.
